Name: Lord Dracon's Item Replicators
Author: BasiliskL
Description:
4 Crystalarium style machines with 7 tiers per machine with a variety of config options.
Higher tiers are unlocked by mail from Demetrius (fertilizer), Clint (mining), the Wizard (mob loot), and Robin (resource) after reaching specific milestones
Tier 2: 2 hearts
Tier 3: 3 hearts
Tier 4: 4 hearts
Tier 5: 5 hearts
Tier 6: 6 hearts AND visited Ginger Island farm area
Tier 7: 10 hearts

Resources are divided 3 rarities for cost and time required.

[u][b]Fertilizer Generator[/b][/u]
[u]Basic/Common:[/u] Basic Fertilizer, Speed-Gro, Basic Retaining Soil, Tree Fertilizer
[u]Quality/Uncommon:[/u] Quality Fertilizer, Deluxe Speed-Gro, Quality Retaining Soil
[u]Deluxe/Rare:[/u] Deluxe Fertilizer, Hyper Speed-Gro, Deluxe Retaining Soil

[b][u]Mining Drill[/u][/b] (has to be outside to work)
[u]Basic/Common:[/u] Bone Fragment, Clay, Coal, Stone,
[u]Quality/Uncommon:[/u] Cinder Shard, Copper Ore, Iron Ore, Gold Ore, Iridium Ore
[u]Deluxe/Rare:[/u] Prismatic Shard, Radioactive Ore

[b][u]Mob Loot Generator[/u][/b]
[u]Basic/Common:[/u] Slime, Bat Wing, Bone Fragment
[u]Quality/Uncommon:[/u] Solar Essence, Void Essence, Cinder Shard
[u]Deluxe/Rare:[/u] Dragon Tooth, Prismatic Shard
[b]
[/b][b][u]Resource Generator[/u][/b]
[u]Basic/Common:[/u] Fiber, Sap, Wood
[u]Quality/Uncommon:[/u] Hardwood

[u][b]Defaults[/b][/u] (Can be changed in config)
Basic/Common resources cost 100 to activate and produce every 3 hours.
Quality/Uncommon resources cost 50 and produce every 6 hours.
Deluxe/Rare resources cost 10 and produce every 12 hours.

All rarities produce the same amounts by default but can be changed for each rarity separately.
Tier 1: 4-6
Tier 2: 8-12
Tier 3: 16-24
Tier 4: 32-48
Tier 5: 64-96
Tier 6: 128-192
Tier 7: 256-384
